content: DMN FEEL built-in function library categories: Conversion (string, number, date, time, date and time, duration, years and months duration - parse/create types), String (substring, string length, upper/lower case, substring before/after, replace (regex), contains, starts/ends with, matches (regex), split (regex), string join), List (list contains, count, min, max, sum, mean, all, any, sublist, append, concatenate, insert before, remove, reverse, index of, union, distinct values, flatten, product, median, stddev, mode, sort, list replace), Numeric (decimal, floor, ceiling, round up/down/half up/half down, abs, modulo, sqrt, log, exp, odd, even), Date/Time (now, today, day of year, day of week, month of year, week of year), Context (context, context put, context merge, get value, get entries - DMN 1.4+), Boolean (not), Range ordering (before, after, meets, met by, overlaps, finishes, includes, during, starts, coincides), Equality (is).
